P.name: Traveler's Call
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Ancient Chimes:}} '''Bard's''' presence causes sacred [[File:Traveler's Call Minimap.png|16px|link=]] {{as|Chimes|buzzword2}} to periodically appear at random locations on the battlefield, lingering for up to 10 minutes. Collecting a {{as|Chime|buzzword2}} restores {{sti|mana|{{as|12% '''maximum''' mana}}}} and grants '''Bard''' {{sti|Experience|{{as|20 + (''1 per minute after 5 minutes'') experience}}}}, as well as {{sti|ms|{{as|24% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} [[combat status|out of combat]] for 20 seconds, which stacks up to 10 times. Each {{as|Chime|buzzword2}} collected beyond the first instead grants an additional {{as|14% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, up to a total of {{as|150% '''bonus''' movement speed}}. '''Bard''' empowers his {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} each time he collects {{as|5 Chimes|buzzword2}}.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Meeps:}} '''Bard's''' presence attracts {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} every few seconds, which are small spirits that come to his side. While he has {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}}, his basic attacks are empowered to each consume a {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|30|magic damage}} (''+ {{as|6|magic damage}} per 5 {{as|Chimes|buzzword2}} collected'') {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
* At {{as|5 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} {{tip|slow}} damaged enemies by {{pp|type = number of Chimes|key=%|25 to 75 for 6|5;25;45;60;75;85}} for 1 second.
* At {{as|15 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} deal the damage to enemies within 150 units of the primary target as well as those in a cone behind them.
* At {{as|35 Chimes|buzzword2}}, the cone's radius increases.
P.description3: '''Bard''' can have up to {{pp|type = number of Chimes|1 to 9 for 9|0;10;30;50;65;80;90;95;100}} {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} at a time.
P.static: {{dv|{{tt|50|Chime spawn rate}}|{{tt|{{pp|changedisplay=true|type = number of Chimes|8 to 4 for 5|0;20;40;55;70}}|Meep spawn rate}}}}

Q.name: Cosmic Binding
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' fires an energy bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 60% for a duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.8}} seconds}}
Q.description2: After ''Cosmic Binding'' hits an enemy, the bolt continues behind them for {{tt|300 units|Estimated}}. If the bolt hits terrain or a second enemy, it {{tip|stun|stuns}} both targets for the same duration, dealing the same damage to the secondary target.

W.name: Caretaker's Shrine
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' conjures a shrine at the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings for 1 second and gathers power over 5 seconds. Up to 3 shrines may be active at a time. Shrines may last indefinitely until being consumed by a champion moving over them.
W.description2: If the champion is an ally or '''Bard''' himself, they are {{tip|heal|healed}} for an amount based on the shrine's power and gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} can [[stack]] with subsequent shrines triggered. If the champion is an enemy, the shrine is destroyed.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|25 to 125}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|50 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description3: '''Bard''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Caretaker's Shrine'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

E.name: Magical Journey
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' opens a one-way magical corridor through a piece of [[terrain]] in the target direction for 10 seconds.
E.description2: A champion can {{tip|dash|pass}} through the corridor by selecting it while within proximity of it, becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} during the travel. '''Bard''' and allies travel through the portal at 33% increased speed.
E.description3: ''A valid piece of terrain within the target range is required to cast this ability. Magical Journey cannot be taken while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''

R.name: Tempered Fate
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bard''' sends magical energy arcing to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area during travel. Upon impact, it puts all units within into {{tip|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, as well as {{tip|stun|stunning}} all enemy {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|turret|turrets}} struck for the same duration. Enemies hit are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for the duration.
R.description2: ''Epic {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|turrets}} are affected by Tempered Fate despite being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}.''
